import Mathlib.Analysis.Real.Sqrt
import Mathlib.Tactic
#check_failure Roth.sum_inv_lt
namespace SumInvHelpers
open Finset
theorem inv_add_inv_le {lam x : ℝ} (hlam : 1 < lam) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx2 : x ≤ 2) :
    (lam - 1 + x)⁻¹ + (lam - 1 + (2 - x))⁻¹ ≤ 2 * lam / (lam ^ 2 - 1) := by
  have ha : 0 < lam - 1 + x := by linarith
  have hb : 0 < lam - 1 + (2 - x) := by linarith
  rw [inv_add_inv ha.ne' hb.ne', div_le_div_iff₀ (mul_pos ha hb) (by nlinarith)]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hx0 (sub_nonneg.2 hx2)]

theorem sum_inv_le {r : ℕ} (hr : 1 ≤ r) {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 1 < lam) :
    ∑ j ∈ range (r + 1), (lam - 1 + 2 * (j : ℝ) / r)⁻¹ ≤ (r + 1) * (lam / (lam ^ 2 - 1)) := by
  have hr' : (0 : ℝ) < r := by exact_mod_cast hr
  have h := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j (hj : j ∈ range (r + 1)) ↦ by
    have hjr : j ≤ r := Nat.lt_succ_iff.1 (mem_range.1 hj)
    have hx2 : 2 * (j : ℝ) / r ≤ 2 := by
      rw [div_le_iff₀ hr']
      gcongr
    simpa only [show 2 - 2 * (j : ℝ) / r = 2 * ((r + 1 - 1 - j : ℕ) : ℝ) / r by
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.cast_sub hjr]
      field_simp] using inv_add_inv_le hlam (by positivity) hx2
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_range_reflect (fun j : ℕ ↦ (lam - 1 + 2 * (j : ℝ) / r)⁻¹),
    Finset.sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_div_assoc] at h
  push_cast at h
  linarith

end SumInvHelpers
#print axioms SumInvHelpers.inv_add_inv_le
#print axioms SumInvHelpers.sum_inv_le

  push_cast at h
  linarith


theorem sqrtWeak {m lam : ℝ} (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hlam : 2 * √m ≤ lam) :
    √(1 - 1 / m) < 1 - lam⁻¹ ^ 2 := by
  have hsq : 4 * m ≤ lam ^ 2 := by
    nlinarith [Real.sqrt_nonneg m, Real.sq_sqrt (by linarith : 0 ≤ m)]

    rw [Real.sqrt_pos, sub_pos, div_lt_one (by linarith)]
    linarith
  have hsqrt : √(1 - 1 / (m : ℝ)) = √((m : ℝ) - 1) / √(m : ℝ) := by

    field_simp

      rw [hlam']

      exact sqrtWeak (by linarith : (1 : ℝ) ≤ m) hlam
    _ = _ := by
      rw [hsqrt]
      field_simp

import Mathlib.Analysis.Convex.Mul
import Mathlib.Analysis.Real.Sqrt
import Mathlib.Tactic
#check_failure Roth.sum_inv_lt
#check @convexOn_zpow
#check @ConvexOn.le_on_segment'
#check @Finset.sum_range_reflect
#check @Finset.sum_involution
#check @Finset.sum_le_sum
namespace SumInvAbstract
open Finset
theorem inverseConvex : ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ioi 0) (fun x : ℝ ↦ x⁻¹) := by
  simpa using (convexOn_zpow (𝕜 := ℝ) (-1))
theorem convexPair {s : Set ℝ} {f : ℝ → ℝ} (hf : ConvexOn ℝ s f)
    {a b t : ℝ} (ha : a ∈ s) (hb : b ∈ s) (ht0 : 0 ≤ t) (ht1 : t ≤ 1) :
    f ((1 - t) * a + t * b) + f (t * a + (1 - t) * b) ≤ f a + f b := by
  have h1 := hf.2 ha hb (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1) ht0 (by ring : 1 - t + t = 1)
  have h2 := hf.2 ha hb ht0 (sub_nonneg.mpr ht1) (by ring : t + (1 - t) = 1)
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h1 h2
  nlinarith
theorem reflectedSum {r : ℕ} {f : ℕ → ℝ} {C : ℝ}
    (h : ∀ j ∈ range (r + 1), f j + f (r - j) ≤ C) :
    2 * ∑ j ∈ range (r + 1), f j ≤ (r + 1) * C := by
  have hh := Finset.sum_le_sum h
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_const, card_range, nsmul_eq_mul] at hh
  have he : (∑ j ∈ range (r + 1), f (r - j)) = ∑ j ∈ range (r + 1), f j := by
    simpa only [Nat.add_sub_cancel] using (Finset.sum_range_reflect f (r + 1))
  rw [he] at hh
  push_cast at hh
  exact (by linarith : 2 * ∑ j ∈ range (r + 1), f j ≤ (r + 1) * C)
end SumInvAbstract
#print axioms SumInvAbstract.inverseConvex
#print axioms SumInvAbstract.convexPair
#print axioms SumInvAbstract.reflectedSum
